scope: Runtime archive/restore lifecycle barrier plus Main operation-gate recovery and delete/reset regression checks.
runtimeOwner: Gateway session lifecycle + admission registry + existing session mutation journal table

cases.fault: Archive while a session is active or still owns queued/process/subagent state.
cases.expected: cleanupSessionBeforeMutation fences and drains before any transcript, archive-index or store-row mutation.

cases.fault: Admission fence/drain/owner cleanup returns an unavailable result.
cases.expected: Return unavailable/retryable, release the known-failure fence, and leave transcript, archive index and store row unchanged.

cases.fault: Process stops after transcript/index preparation or after store commit, before runtime finalization.
cases.expected: Same operationId resumes from intent/store_committed state; committed retry returns the saved receipt without rerunning cleanup.

cases.fault: Restore inserts the new store row but process stops before transcript rename and index removal.
cases.expected: Archive index continues filtering the key, and the same operationId completes rename/index cleanup before runtime_committed.

cases.fault: A late run event from the archived physical generation reaches the restored logical session.
cases.expected: Restore assigns a fresh physical sessionId; the old generation remains tombstoned and cannot mutate the new row.

cases.fault: While archive is unknown/pending, a restore or second mutation kind is requested for the same SessionKey.
cases.expected: The persisted Main gate rejects the different mutation kind; only the original operationId can retry.

cases.fault: The archive RPC times out or returns no matching runtime_committed receipt.
cases.expected: Main does not hide success or clear the gate; retry uses the same operationId and succeeds only on a matching receipt.

cases.fault: Archive index exists while the runtime store row has not yet been removed (crash window).
cases.expected: sessions.list excludes the key by archive-index membership before the store commit is complete.

cases.fault: Shared journal/finalizer refactor regresses existing delete/reset/terminal semantics.
cases.expected: Delete tombstone, reset fence release, terminal keep-on-leave and existing partial-delete behavior remain unchanged.

knownLimitations: Permanent deletion of an already archived conversation remains in the existing Main archive-index/cascade path; it is covered by partial-failure tests but is not moved into the runtime archive RPC.
The A2 E2E covers one isolated local workspace; multi-workspace acceptance belongs to F1.
A test-only dependency injection is not used to fabricate provider activity; active-drain behavior is tested through the existing finalizer regression path.
